title: Helen McCall's Sol Foundation white paper on UAPs and financial stability
summary: Matthew Pines tells of Helen McCall's Sol Foundation white paper on UAPs and financial stability, about 2024 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Helen McCall wrote a white paper for the soul foundation on this exact question of essentially UAPs and financial stability risk

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a researcher named Matthew Pines says that a writer named Helen McCall wrote a white paper, a short policy report, for an organisation called the Sol Foundation. According to Pines, around 2024 the paper looked at how UAPs, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, could pose a risk to financial stability. The point of telling it is that serious people are asking what news of non-human craft might do to markets and the economy.
